name: A Lazy Magic Teacher
source:
In this visual novel you play as Mike, a fat and failing wizard, in his quest to uncensor a photo of a naked woman. Your choices will determine the outcome.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104710/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
在这部视觉小说中，你扮演迈克，一个肥胖且失败的巫师，他的任务是审查一张裸体女人的照片。你的选择将决定结果。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1104710/]Steam[/url]]
